registration.method: One whole-model similarity registration, 15 m/viewer unit, following the WoWS viewer scale used by the shared reference stage. No component fitting. Source waterline and game refit remain unverified.

limitations: Optional empty components are recorded in files.
Hull and superstructure may be fused in the reference chunks. Hull-only close-ups use camera framing; no geometry-derived sections or shape measurements are exported.

historicalAccuracy: Not certified; recognition plan and dated photographs interpreted, hull lines reconstructed.
